method: Independently reproduce the camera support-function fit and affine leading-edge pull, then project every actual Three.js SphereGeometry vertex at sampled wobble and independently varied pull angles and all four legal center corners. Numerical geometry/code-review evidence; not browser, frame-rate, touch or perception evidence.

assumptions.geometry: SphereGeometry(1,96,64); clipped z=max(.007,(sphereZ+.64)*.62), with renderer taper, then wobble rotation/scale, then pull affine, then legal body translation.
assumptions.continuousBound: The pull XY block I+e*n*nT has singular values (1+e,1), so independent pull and wobble directions lie inside the XY radius multiplied by maxPullScale. Pull translation length is <=r*MAX_PULL/2. Z scale is positive 1/(1+e), making minZScale the smallest possible Z scale. The circular XY ellipsoid support plus taper XY/Z and translation bounds every angle and pull strength in [0,MAX_PULL]. Samples validate representative shapes at full pull.
assumptions.limitations: The support argument assumes enforced stretch, squash and pull limits. Samples are finite and do not validate optical perception, browser update timing, touch input, contact shadow extent or subjective weight.

codeReview.volumeInterpretation: Added pull affine determinant is 1: XY extension cancels Z reduction. Existing wobble/taper volume approximation is unchanged.
codeReview.matrixOrder: world = bodyTranslation * pullAffine * wobbleRotation * wobbleScale * taperedLocalVertex
codeReview.opticalMatrices: dropGroup.updateMatrixWorld(true) propagates the manual pullGroup matrix before uDropToWorld/uWorldToDrop are copied from drop.matrixWorld. Inverse-transpose normals and unnormalized local rays in findExit incorporate the complete affine.
codeReview.contact: contactGroup uses bodyTranslation * pullAffine, with matching wobble angle and XY scales on children. Contact and caustic remain registered with the pulled body.
codeReview.reset: reset() clears simulation, motion and pull, then deform(0) writes an identity pull affine. Reduced-motion option clears both visual helpers before deform(0).
codeReview.finding: No correctness issue identified in pull transform, optical matrix propagation, contact alignment, reset path or camera envelope. The analytic interior ellipsoid remains an approximation to the small taper, as before.
